invariants.description: valves are ideal diodes: all valve flows >= 0
atrial pressure-volume laws u_A = E_A (q_A - q_A_us) (constant elastance; units converted)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(u_LA, 1.0*E_LA*(q_LA - 1.0*q_LA_us), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*np.max(np.abs(u_LA))) & np.allclose(u_RA, 1.0*E_RA*(q_RA - 1.0*q_RA_us), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*np.max(np.abs(u_RA)))

invariants.description: valve laws: open valve flow = pressure drop / R, closed = 0 (aortic and mitral)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(v_AV, np.where(u_LV > u_root, (u_LV - u_root)/(1.0*R_AV), 0.0), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*np.max(np.abs(v_AV))) & np.allclose(v_MV, np.where(u_LA > u_LV, (u_LA - u_LV)/(1.0*R_MV), 0.0), rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-9*np.max(np.abs(v_MV)))

invariants.description: ventricular elastance E = u/(q - q_us) follows the prescribed activation exactly: E(mt) = (Emax - Emin)(x) exp((1 - x^2)/2) + Emin, x = min(mt, 0.4)/To_pk, for mt < 0.6, Emin after (mt = t/T mod 1; points within 1e-6 of a switch are skipped)
invariants.expr: np.allclose((u_LV/(q_LV - 1.0*q_LV_us))[np.abs(np.mod(t/T, 1) - 0.6) > 1e-6], (1.0*(np.where(np.mod(t/T, 1) < 0.6, (E_LVmax - E_LVmin)*(np.minimum(np.mod(t/T, 1), 0.4)/To_pk)*np.exp(0.5*(1 - (np.minimum(np.mod(t/T, 1), 0.4)/To_pk)**2)), 0.0) + E_LVmin))[np.abs(np.mod(t/T, 1) - 0.6) > 1e-6], rtol=1e-7) & np.allclose((u_RV/(q_RV - 1.0*q_RV_us))[np.abs(np.mod(t/T, 1) - 0.6) > 1e-6], (1.0*(np.where(np.mod(t/T, 1) < 0.6, (E_RVmax - E_RVmin)*(np.minimum(np.mod(t/T, 1), 0.4)/To_pk)*np.exp(0.5*(1 - (np.minimum(np.mod(t/T, 1), 0.4)/To_pk)**2)), 0.0) + E_RVmin))[np.abs(np.mod(t/T, 1) - 0.6) > 1e-6], rtol=1e-7)

invariants.description: volume balance of the whole heart: q(t) - q(0) = integral of (v_pvn + v_ivc + v_svc - v_AV - v_PV)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q - q[0] - np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((v_pvn + v_ivc + v_svc - v_AV - v_PV)[1:] + (v_pvn + v_ivc + v_svc - v_AV - v_PV)[:-1])*np.diff(t))]))) <= 2e-2*(np.max(q) - np.min(q)) + 1e-9*np.max(q)

invariants.description: periodic steady state after 10 beats: the last cycle repeats the previous one (volumes within 0.1 %)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_LV[t >= t[-1] - T] - np.interp(t[t >= t[-1] - T] - T, t, q_LV))) <= 1e-3*np.max(q_LV)

invariants.description: at the periodic state the ejected volume per beat equals the inflow per beat: integral of v_AV over the last cycle = v_pvn T and of v_PV = (v_ivc + v_svc) T (within 0.5 %)
invariants.expr: abs(np.sum(0.5*(v_AV[t >= t[-1] - T][1:] + v_AV[t >= t[-1] - T][:-1])*np.diff(t[t >= t[-1] - T])) - v_pvn*T) <= 5e-3*v_pvn*T and abs(np.sum(0.5*(v_PV[t >= t[-1] - T][1:] + v_PV[t >= t[-1] - T][:-1])*np.diff(t[t >= t[-1] - T])) - (v_ivc + v_svc)*T) <= 5e-3*(v_ivc + v_svc)*T

bc_sweep.rationale: Aortic root pressure 8-16 kPa (60-120 mmHg) and pulmonary artery pressure 1-3.5 kPa (7.5-26 mmHg) span normal and hypo/hypertensive afterloads; every other constant (elastances, unstressed volumes, valve resistances, T, To_pk, venous inflows) at 0.5-2x nominal. delay only affects the unused output mta.

baseline.reason: candidate: normal adult LV pressure-volume loop (EDV ~120 mL, ESV ~50 mL, LVSP ~120 mmHg) e.g. Bozkurt2019 Fig./Table of adult haemodynamics; needs the isolated heart coupled to a closed loop (constant BCs cannot give a physiological loop) and a heart source for this elastance shape
